title: Azalea Bangtao Villas
shortDescription: A small boutique pool-villa development in the Bang Jo area of Cherng Talay/Si Sunthon.
description: A small boutique pool-villa development in the Bang Jo area of Cherng Talay/Si Sunthon. Portal sources describe it as a few minutes from Bang Tao Beach, Laguna and Boat Avenue-area attractions, with only a handful of villas left for sale.
